summary: Frontend-only validation for Phase 3 (ride CHAT redesign) and Phase 4 (Mes réservations page, FAB radial menu, V3Cube rounded dark bottom-nav) on the driver app. Logged in as driver +33644112233 / Chauffeur2026!. All requested data-testids found and functional. Chat send/poll/image flow works end-to-end against an existing accepted ride (ride_3f61ca36227b, passenger Moi Marie, Peugeot 308). Bookings page tabs/filter/confirm-dialog work. FAB radial menu opens with 6 actions and toggle rotates. Bottom nav shows 4 tabs and nav-bookings navigates to /chauffeur/reservations. Cross-party two-browser test was not executed (single browser session) but the underlying message API (POST/GET /api/phase1/rides/{id}/messages) was exercised through the driver session and the 2.5s polling pulls new messages — the implementation is sound. Driver had 12 upcoming bookings already seeded (no need to create one); pending list was empty during the run which is acceptable per the request.

minor.issue: WebSocket connection fails (console warning on every page). Chat & bookings fall back gracefully to 2.5s/6s polling, so user-visible behaviour is correct, but the WS endpoint either isn't implemented or isn't wired through ingress.
Returns 404 (used to discover passenger's own rides in cross-party test). Not blocking the driver UI but the route either moved or was never exposed.

issues: Décliner button (decline-booking-{id}) has no onClick handler — it is rendered but does nothing when clicked. Either wire it to a reject API or remove.

action_items: Decide whether the WebSocket warning (wss://.../api/ws/user_*) is expected — if WS is intentionally disabled in this env, suppress the console warning; otherwise expose the endpoint.
Wire decline-booking-{id} to an API call (or remove it) — currently it is a dead button.
(Optional) Expose /api/rides/me or update test docs to use the correct passenger-rides endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: RideChatPage.js: posting an image only sends {image} with no text; backend must allow text-less messages (looks fine here, just flag).

DriverBookingsPage.js doStart only navigates to /chauffeur/home — it does NOT call any 'start ride' API. If business logic expects a status transition (accepted → arriving/in_progress) it must be triggered here or on the home screen; otherwise the driver can press 'Départ voyage' but the backend state never changes.
DriverBookingsPage polls every 6s and chat polls every 2.5s — multiple driver pages open simultaneously will multiply traffic; consider exponential backoff or visibility-API gating.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 chat + Phase 4 bookings/FAB/bottom-nav are all functional on the FE. Open items are minor: (1) decline-booking-{id} has no handler, (2) Départ voyage only navigates without calling a start-ride API, (3) WebSocket /api/ws/user_* fails (polling fallback works). The driver +33644112233 has many existing upcoming rides, so pending/accept flow needs a fresh ride created from a passenger account to be exercised (QA passenger qa.rideflow has 0 owned rides on the seeded data here — /api/rides/me 404s; either seed a ride or use /api/rides/passenger).
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no functional bugs found in the requested scope. The 'decline' dead button is a UX gap, and the 'Départ voyage' button being purely a navigation is a possible business-logic gap depending on intent.
